start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunke lag raha hai ki aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi okay hain?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Bilkul, aapne chaaron sides jodi: 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30 equals 160 metre. Isi ko perimeter kehte hain—Bittu ko kaise batayenge?
